svg.title: T15.3_coverage_regression_strategy
svg.text: Coverage answers what evidence exists; regression tiers decide when evidence is strong enough to sign off.

text.tspan: family, block length, RV, Qm, CRC, reset and CBG
and replay tests with stable seeds.
functional bins, cross bins, code coverage,
pre-commit, commit, nightly, weekly and release
required bins closed, no unclassified failures,
failure bundles complete and reports archived.

Coverage is not test count. A thousand random frames can still miss RV2 with reset, Polar CRC24 with PM tie, or LDPC CBG hold after partial retransmission. Every bin must map to an observable field, a vector class, a failure class, or a coverage report line.

Failure triage order: reproduce by seed -> classify infrastructure/DUT/golden/protocol descriptor -> find first mismatch -> attach bundle -> decide fix, waiver, or new bin. Sign-off requires evidence, not confidence: bin report, code/assertion report, nightly summary, replay commands, open-risk list and
